description_en: Retrieves skill group summary reports by calling the ListSkillGroupSummaryReports operation
description_zh: 调用接口：ListSkillGroupSummaryReports获取技能组汇总报表
name: ListSkillGroupSummaryReports

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of skill group IDs, separated by commas (,). A maximum of 50 IDs can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all skill groups are queried
parameters.help_zh: 技能组ID列表，使用“,”隔开，最多50个；不传查询全部
parameters.name: skill_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Only day-level queries are supported. Refer to the examples for parameter settings. The start date cannot be earlier than 31 days before the current date
parameters.help_zh: 起始日期，格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，；需要注意目前仅支持按天维度的查询，参数设置请参考案例，同时不得早于31天前的时间点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Only day-level queries are supported. Refer to the examples for parameter settings
parameters.help_zh: 终止日期，格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；需要注意目前仅支持按天维度的查询，参数设置请参考案例
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大是100
parameters.name: page_size
